_meta.note: V2 rewrite regression reference. Schema: what_matters/before_you_go/route_choice/watch_for/check_in_plan/verified_local_info/bottom_line — no risk_level anywhere. Verified live: (1) a route with a stated lighting/route-choice concern gets grounded, non-inventive guidance plus a fully-sourced verified_local_info entry from a real web_search hit (source_name+source_date_or_status+source_url all populated); (2) a short simple daytime walk with no concerns correctly returns route_choice.useful:false and check_in_plan.worth_considering:false rather than padding them; (3) an unfamiliar-city late-night case with an underpass/garage mentioned treats the underpass as something to route around by choice, never as inherently unsafe, and cites two real construction-project sources. router.outputGuard caught and repaired at least one violation on every one of 4 live test calls this session (self_explanation, invented_fact, mind_reading, unsupported_prediction, searched_fact_without_traceable_source, false_precision) — confirms the guard wiring works, not a sign the prompt is unreliable; the captured outputs below are POST-repair (what a real visitor would see).
